subject: Renewal true‑up: credit waterfall, PO conversion, and wire acceptance checklist
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: accounts-payable@hypernova.ai, andrea.santos@hypernova.ai
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Sep 2028 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal true‑up: credit waterfall, PO conversion, and wire acceptance checklist

Hi Andrea / AP team,

Thanks again for the quick renewal signature this week. We ran the final consumption reconciliation for the quarter and there are two items that need to be closed to complete the invoice:

• Credit waterfall: you have an unused prepaid credit from the prior term (ref HN‑CREDIT‑2027) that should be applied before the final true‑up invoice is issued. We propose applying the credit in the following order: (1) prorated over the remaining subscription lines, (2) offset against usage overage, (3) residual applied to end‑term invoice.

• PO conversion: your procurement team requested a PO to be attached to the final invoice so it can be processed by the treasury team. Attached is a draft PO file (HN‑PO‑8814‑2028.pdf) that we can convert to your format — please confirm acceptance or attach your PO.

• Wire acceptance & tax routing: HyperNova is EU‑based and has indicated reverse‑charge may apply. To avoid payment delay, please confirm the wire acceptance bucket (EUR account vs local country execution) and whether you require our VAT certificate or W‑8 (we included HN‑vat‑residency‑certificate.pdf for reference).

Action items I need from you by EOD Mon 2028‑10‑02:
1) Confirmation to apply the HN‑CREDIT‑2027 credit per the waterfall above.
2) Either confirmation of the attached PO or the official PO file to attach to redwood‑invoice‑2028Q3‑8814.pdf.
3) Confirmation of wire routing preference and any required tax evidence.

Kimberly / Marissa — looping you in to confirm: (a) internal acceptance of the credit waterfall, (b) ability to produce the final invoice with the PO, and (c) that Finance is OK with the proposed wire bucket.

Thanks — we want to avoid an escrow or holdback and get the invoice cleared in this cycle.

Best,
Sergio
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555‑0198

Attachments: HN-PO-8814-2028.pdf, redwood-invoice-2028Q3-8814.pdf, HN-vat-residency-certificate.pdf

From: Andrea Santos <andrea.santos@hypernova.ai>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@hypernova.ai
Date: Fri, 29 Sep 2028 08:17:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal true‑up: credit waterfall, PO conversion, and wire acceptance checklist

Hi Sergio — thank you. Confirming receipt and next steps from our side:

• Credit: Procurement has reviewed HN‑CREDIT‑2027. We agree with the proposed waterfall; please show the application line‑by‑line on the final invoice so our AP can validate.

• PO: attached is HyperNova_PO_8814_2028.pdf (we converted to our format). Please attach it to the final invoice before sending to AP.

• Wires / tax: We will route via our EUR treasury account (local execution). Reverse‑charge should apply for the subscription line items but not for professional services (if any). We need Redwood’s VAT certificate and an invoice line that indicates reverse‑charge on the subscription rows.

We expect to clear payment within standard Net 30 of receipt once the PO is on the invoice and the reverse‑charge is indicated. If anything blocks processing after that, we will flag immediately.

Regards,
Andrea Santos
Procurement Manager | HyperNova
andrea.santos@hypernova.ai

Attachments: HyperNova_PO_8814_2028.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Andrea Santos <andrea.santos@hypernova.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Oct 2028 13:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal true‑up: credit waterfall, PO conversion, and wire acceptance checklist

Thanks Andrea — noted. Internal update:

• Finance will produce a revised final invoice with the credit waterfall displayed as three lines (prorate, usage offset, residual) and attach both the HyperNova_PO_8814_2028.pdf and the VAT certificate.
• We’ll mark subscription lines with reverse‑charge language and include the VAT registration IDs on the invoice header.
• Expected invoice issue: Tue 2028‑10‑03 EOD.

Marissa — can you confirm DocuSign for the amended commercial addendum? If we need a signed confirmation for the credit application order, we should capture it now.

Sergio — once the invoice is out I’ll share wire account details for the EUR bucket so HyperNova can match the beneficiary to their treasury.

Kimberly Park
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Andrea — appreciate the quick turnaround and the PO.

We issued the revised invoice (redwood‑invoice‑2028Q3‑8814.pdf) and attached the HyperNova PO and VAT certificate. Marissa has sent a one‑paragraph acknowledgement via DocuSign for the credit waterfall; you should see an email from docusign@redwood.com — please sign so we have the paper trail your AP requires.

Next steps (summary):
• HyperNova signs DocuSign acknowledgement (Marissa) — expected today.
• AP processes revised invoice with attached PO and reverse‑charge notation — net 30.
• Kimberly will send the EUR wire beneficiary details and remittance format to accounts‑payable@hypernova.ai by EOD Mon 2028‑10‑08 if needed for routing.

If anything slips, flag me and I will escalate to CS/finance to avoid holdback.

Thanks again — closing this one out.
